# criblio_search_sources (Data Source)

Returns all matching objects in `items`, following API pagination automatically. Scope the request using the required attributes below. An empty collection returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_search_sources" "my_searchsources" {
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `auth_tokens` (Attributes List) Authentication tokens. An empty list clears all tokens. After writing configured tokens, removing this attribute or setting it to null clears them. Unconfigured tokens from legacy or imported resources are preserved. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--auth_tokens))
- `cribl_api` (String) Absolute path for Cribl HTTP API requests. Used when type is cribl_http.
- `description` (String) Optional description shown in configuration UIs.
- `disabled` (Boolean) When true, the source does not accept new connections.
- `elastic_api` (String) Absolute path for Elasticsearch bulk API requests. Used when type is elastic.
- `host` (String) Bind address for the listener.
- `id` (String) Source configuration id.
- `metadata` (Attributes List) Fields to add to events from the Source. Can be a static value or a JavaScript expression. Useful for enriching events with additional context, such as environment or custom identifiers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--metadata))
- `port` (Integer) TCP port when the source type uses a single port field.
- `prometheus_api` (String) Absolute path for Prometheus remote write requests. Used when type is prometheus_rw.
- `splunk_hec_acks` (Boolean) When true, enable Splunk HEC acknowledgements. Used when type is splunk_hec.
- `splunk_hec_api` (String) Absolute path for Splunk HTTP Event Collector (HEC) API requests. Required when type is splunk_hec.
- `subscriptions` (Attributes List) WEF subscriptions; required when type is wef. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--subscriptions))
- `tcp_port` (Integer) TCP listen port when the source type uses a dedicated TCP port.
- `tls` (Attributes) TLS material and policy for this listener (shape varies by source type). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--tls))
- `type` (String) Protocol discriminator selecting the ingest source protocol and listener shape.
- `udp_port` (Integer) UDP listen port when applicable.

<a id="nestedatt--items--auth_tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.auth_tokens`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Optional label for this token.
- `enabled` (Boolean) When false, the token is rejected.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Inline token for Raw HTTP and Splunk HEC; stored text-secret ID for Cribl HTTP. Raw HTTP accepts enabled omitted or true; remove an entry to disable it.
- `token_secret` (String) Stored text-secret ID for Raw HTTP or Splunk HEC. Configure exactly one of token or token_secret. The provider sends authType secret for this reference.

<a id="nestedatt--items--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.metadata`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Field name to stamp onto the emitted event.
- `value` (String) Value for the field. Can be a static string or a JavaScript expression.

<a id="nestedatt--items--subscriptions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.subscriptions`

Read-Only:

- `subscription_name` (String) Subscription name exposed to Windows clients.
- `version` (String) Version UUID for this subscription.
- `content_format` (String) Content format for delivered events.
- `heartbeat_interval` (Number) Maximum seconds between endpoint check-ins before marking unavailable.
- `batch_timeout` (Number) Seconds to collect events before sending to Cribl.
- `targets` (List of String) DNS names of endpoints that forward these events.
- `id` (String)
- `query_selector` (String) Query builder mode; simple with queries, or xml with xmlQuery.
- `queries` (Attributes List) Path and XPath selector entries when using simple mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--subscriptions--queries))
- `xml_query` (String) XPath query when using xml mode.

<a id="nestedatt--items--subscriptions--queries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.subscriptions.queries`

Read-Only:

- `path` (String)
- `query_expression` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--items--tls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.tls`

Read-Only:

- `cert_path` (String) Filesystem or cloud path to the certificate PEM.
- `disabled` (Boolean) When true, TLS is not terminated on this listener.
- `min_version` (String) Minimum TLS protocol version.
- `priv_key_path` (String) Filesystem or cloud path to the private key PEM.
